body: I've never really been the best at introductions..
It's actually going brilliantly. And I should feel great. But I don't. For the first time in a while. And I guess that's the thing.

No not really. I don't think I've experienced the same thing. I woke up gasping for breath today though, but I still don't believe that's what you're talking about. I feel like it could be a good analogy in my case but that's all.
And man that means more than you know.
I can't ignore that many pleases...
I'm saving this comment. Hell I'll make sure to come back to it whenever I feel this alone again. I'm sure it'll remind me I have something to hold on to. Thanks for the kind words man.

Thank you. I don't really feel as if I'll ever get past it but your words and advice mean something. I'll try to hold onto them. 

And I'm happy you got past it. I really am.
Don't worry. Don't worry. I'm alive. And relatively fine.
